dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: Hey, I was wondering if we could look into getting a car. I need to get to campus and work, and the buses don't always run when I need them to.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: A car? But, that's a lot of money.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: I know but I thought you'd been saving up for both of us.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: I'll see what I can do.
